registered: 2026-10-06, before any v5 computation (Test Lead ruling: known-bad by behaviour, defined before data)
extends: quiz-registry-v3.json (Q0-Q2) and quiz-registry-v4.json (Q3); designs, sizes, k grid, draws and RNG unchanged
supersedes_label: v3/v4's known-bad set (EV5's 8 Track A constructions plus the run-5 winner): the constructions' EV5 FAIL was condition-specific, so they are not known-bad by behaviour

Q2_and_Q3: control-localized_sign_error (constructed: sign error near the limits)
Q3_only: mode-x-aggressive: a synthetic decider that, in each scenario, picks the fastest protocol on the grid by the reference, ignoring every constraint (the per-scenario Mode X pick)

known_good: unchanged: control-oracle, control-conservative, control-rank_preserving_delay and the best quarter of EV4's real members by development decision value

q3_rules.all_infeasible: a scenario whose reference grid has no feasible design has the correct answer 'none feasible' (abstain); a pick there is a decision false-feasible only if the model called it safe (SELECTED_INFEASIBLE)
q3_rules.pool: quiz scenarios are drawn only from scenarios with at least one reference-feasible design; the number of all-infeasible scenarios in the pool is reported
